findings.title: Generate the queued timestamp for each AssignmentSource instance
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated once when this module is imported, so every AssignmentSource created without an explicit `queued` value receives the same worker-startup timestamp. In a long-running process, the context serialized into outbound tasks therefore records an incorrect queue time. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` to generate a fresh timestamp for each instance.
